clauses.normalized_text: Unlike TLS over TCP, QUIC applications that want to send data do not send it through TLS "application_data" records.
clauses.raw_text: Unlike TLS over TCP, QUIC applications that want to send data do not send it through TLS "application_data" records.

clauses.normalized_text: Rather, they send it as QUIC STREAM frames or other frame types, which are then carried in QUIC packets.
clauses.raw_text: Rather, they send it as QUIC STREAM frames or other frame types, which are then carried in QUIC packets.

clauses.normalized_text: QUIC carries TLS handshake data in CRYPTO frames, each of which consists of a contiguous block of handshake data identified by an offset and length.
clauses.raw_text: QUIC carries TLS handshake data in CRYPTO frames, each of which consists of a contiguous block of handshake data identified by an offset and length.

clauses.normalized_text: Those frames are packaged into QUIC packets and encrypted under the current TLS encryption level.
clauses.raw_text: Those frames are packaged into QUIC packets and encrypted under the current TLS encryption level.

clauses.raw_text: As with TLS over TCP, once TLS handshake data has been delivered to QUIC, it is QUIC's responsibility to deliver it reliably.

clauses.normalized_text: In this document, the TLS handshake is considered complete when the TLS stack has reported that the handshake is complete.
clauses.raw_text: In this document, the TLS handshake is considered complete when the TLS stack has reported that the handshake is complete.

clauses.normalized_text: This happens when the TLS stack has both sent a Finished message and verified the peer's Finished message.
clauses.raw_text: This happens when the TLS stack has both sent a Finished message and verified the peer's Finished message.

clauses.normalized_text: Verifying the peer's Finished provides the endpoints with an assurance that previous handshake messages have not been modified.

clauses.normalized_text: Note that the handshake does not complete at both endpoints simultaneously.

clauses.normalized_text: Consequently, any requirement that is based on the completion of the handshake depends on the perspective of the endpoint in question.
